description:
The ultimate in value and satiety, Gukbap, the soul food of Koreans. Hong Dal-dal, who dreamed of becoming a Gukbap master, is transported to the other world of the "Kingdom of Karl" after an accidental mishap.

All he knows how to do is make Gukbap. However, with just that one bowl, he opens a restaurant, hits the jackpot, and begins to survive in this other world.
Then, one day, the Demon King eats his Gukbap, regains his power, and massacres all the heroes of this world.

Hong Dal-dal loses everything in an instant. Now, as the only remaining hero, he stands against the Demon King alongside his companions.

Until the day he defeats the Demon King and becomes a true Gukbap Master, Hong Dal-dal's journey continues.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/69251122), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14146970), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/isegye_gukbab_master)
